changes_vs_current: New topic. Raw average-position order (10 averaged people sources): Italy, UK, Japan, Australia, Ireland, France, Canada, Greece, Spain, Mexico, Germany, New Zealand, Switzerland, Netherlands, Bahamas, Iceland, Sweden, Portugal, Finland, Norway, Thailand, Denmark, Costa Rica, Jamaica.

Gut check agreed closely: all 12 gut answers land in the raw top 13. Switzerland (raw #13) left there: New Zealand edges it in Monmouth (4% vs 3%), YouGov popularity (#10 vs #12) and Harris 2008/2010.

Canada moved from #7 to #9 (Greece, Spain up one): its raw rank is lifted by trips actually taken (#2 NTTO), searches and liking, but as a dream destination it is weak: 2% in Monmouth 2024 (15th) and 9th-12th in the Harris polls. YouGov DestinationIndex (Canada 23.8%, #2) keeps it in the top 10.

Sweden (raw #17), Finland (#19) and Denmark (#22) dropped: each rests only on YouGov favorability (liking a country, not wanting to go) and appears in no travel-intent, search or visit source. Norway kept at #21 as the one Scandinavian answer (YouGov #9 of foreign countries).

South Korea (raw #26: Airalo #9, YouGov #27), Dominican Republic (raw #27: NTTO #6 with 3.7M US visits, Lake #14, YouGov #34) and Egypt (raw #30: Monmouth 2%, Provision Living #9, a stock bucket-list answer for the pyramids) added at #22-24 because they have travel-intent, search or visit data.

Label choice: one 'United Kingdom' item takes england/britain/scotland/wales/northern ireland as aliases (Monmouth and Harris also group them), so no separate Scotland or England item. USA excluded by design.
confidence: medium. The top 6 (Italy, UK, Japan, Australia, Ireland, France) hold across a 2024 national poll, three Harris polls, searches and actual trips, and Italy is #1 almost everywhere. But the best recent open-ended poll (Monmouth 2024) has small percentages and stops at about 19 countries, the Harris dream-vacation polls are 2008-2011 (Australia was stronger then, Japan weaker than it is now), and the tail (#14-24) leans on YouGov liking scores, search volume and eSIM data rather than a 'want to visit' question.
